$$

</Path>

$$

$$

</Path>

</Conclusion>
</Parallel>

---

$$

$$
\frac{a}{6} = -1 \Rightarrow a = -6
$$

\boxed{a = -6}

We can set up the integral to find the area above the line $ x = 2y $ within the rectangle.

$$

$$

$$
